stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr health board ‘not functioning as a single coherent organisation’, independent review finds
stories.summary: The health board that runs NHS services in Flintshire and across North Wales does not have what it needs to deliver and sustain improvement, an independent review has concluded. stories.title: Tidal energy firm given £2m to build first turbine for Morlais site off Anglesey
stories.summary: HydroWing will use money from the North Wales Clean Energy Fund to deploy its first tidal device at Morlais in 2027.

stories.title: Deeside-based Iceland’s charity gives Christmas vouchers to almost 600 families of seriously ill children
stories.summary: Deeside-based Iceland’s charity has given £30 Christmas food vouchers to almost 600 families caring for seriously ill children, as part of a partnership built around a £250,000 fund. The Iceland Foods Charitable Foundation is working with Together for Short Lives, a charity that supports seriously ill children, their families and the UK’s 52 children’s hospices.

stories.summary: How many vehicles use each main road in Flintshire on an average day, from the A494 at Queensferry to the A55 and the coast road. Department for Transport traffic counts going back to 2000.

stories.title: RSPCA asks for homes in time for Christmas for dogs including shy husky at Colwyn Bay centre
stories.summary: RSPCA Cymru says Husky Daisy is the longest stay dog at its Bryn Y Maen centre, as it appeals for adopters and fosterers across Wales.
